blocks.text: This page exists only to exercise the parser: a full-width title, a subtitle, and two columns that must never be spliced. A reader that orders lines by vertical position alone will alternate between the columns and produce sentences that start on the left and finish on the right.
The parser groups glyph runs into lines, splits a line wherever the horizontal advance leaves a gutter-sized gap, then cuts the page recursively on the widest band that few lines cross.
Every block it emits carries a page number and a bounding box, so a reviewer can point back at the region the text came from. A synthetic input for pdf-order. No third-party content.
This is the right column. Its first line should follow the last line of the left column, not the first one, and the page number below should come last.
The title and subtitle are wider than either column, so they are spanning elements: the parser emits them before both columns because their vertical extent sits above the column block.
Known limits: vector-outline text and scanned pages with no text layer are reported as uncertainty rather than guessed at.
